title: Zero Reliability! No Customer Support! Good Luck!
content:
I strongly do not recommend this service.

The product failed to deliver the basic functionality that was paid for. I purchased a seven day plan, yet the service only functioned for three days. This constitutes a clear failure to provide the advertised service.

When the service stopped working, customer support was ineffective and obstructive. I was routed through what is presented as live support, but in reality appears to be an automated system that repeatedly requested incremental information. This created unnecessary delays and prevented timely resolution.

The troubleshooting process was excessively burdensome and unreasonable. I was required to complete numerous steps, including repeated device restarts and submission of screenshots, despite having no working internet connection. This consumed over two hours without any resolution.

The escalation process is equally ineffective. It cycles through procedural steps without producing any meaningful support outcome. There is no clear ownership of the issue and no accountability for resolving it.

This service proved to be unreliable at a critical moment when I needed connectivity to seek medical attention. As a result, I was forced to purchase an additional plan, which also failed to function.

At this point, I have paid for services that were not delivered. This is unacceptable from both a service reliability and consumer protection standpoint.

I have formally requested a refund and expect a prompt resolution.

title: Good price, but having connection issues
content:
Holafly offers a competitive price point for its eSIM services, making it an appealing option for travelers who want to stay connected without the hassle of physical SIM cards. I decided to give Holafly a try and purchased a 5-day eSIM plan for use in the United States on my iPad Pro 5G. Initially, the eSIM worked seamlessly once activated, providing a strong and reliable connection. However, a few hours later, I began experiencing intermittent connectivity issues that disrupted my usage. While the affordability of the service is commendable, the reliability of its network performance left much to be desired.

One aspect of Holafly that I found inconvenient was its built-in VPN, which cannot be turned off. This feature seemed to complicate connectivity rather than enhance it, particularly when attempting to use the mobile hotspot feature. Devices connected to the hotspot struggled with extremely slow internet speeds, taking hours to load a single page. This limitation made the hotspot function practically unusable, undermining one of the primary reasons I chose the service. Although Holafly’s pricing and initial performance were promising, the ongoing connectivity issues and technical limitations significantly diminished the overall experience.
